name: Genovac Antibody Discovery
old_description: Genovac specializes in antibody discovery and production against challenging targets. Our unique combination of genetic immunization, multiple host species, multiple single B cell platforms, and state-of-the-art production facilities enables us to serve as your one-stop-shop Gene to Antibody partner.
about:
Genovac Antibody Discovery operates from its headquarters in Fargo, North Dakota, with additional antibody discovery operations in Freiburg, Germany. The company traces its origins to 1999 when three University of Freiburg professors launched the venture based on the institution’s pioneering antibody research. In 2020, a management-led buyout of Aldevron’s antibody discovery business unit relaunched Genovac under its current structure.

The firm specializes in end-to-end antibody discovery and production against challenging targets such as ion channels and GPCRs. Its platform combines genetic immunization, multiple host species, and several single B cell screening technologies—including the Berkeley Lights Beacon instrument—alongside biologics production and a full suite of characterization services. Genovac reports more than 3,600 completed antibody discovery projects and 25 years of cumulative experience.

Genovac serves biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies developing therapeutic and diagnostic products. Its clients include organizations seeking antibodies against difficult multi-transmembrane proteins, though specific customer names are not disclosed.

The company positions itself as a one-stop-shop “Gene to Antibody” partner, emphasizing a unique combination of immunization technologies, species diversity, and screening platforms that aim to deliver hits where competitors fall short. The 2020 relaunch was driven by a goal to redefine the gold standard for difficult-target antibody delivery through continuous technology improvement.
